name: rsa-1024
exercises: weak key, must still parse and be reported

name: ed25519
exercises: Ed25519: key size must be NULL, not 256

name: beyond-2038
exercises: notAfter past the 32-bit epoch; must not wrap

name: wildcard
exercises: wildcard SAN; must NOT cover the bare domain

name: trailing-dot
exercises: fully-qualified name with a trailing dot

name: mixed-case-san
exercises: uppercase SAN must normalise to lowercase

name: ipv6-san
exercises: iPAddress SAN, v6; must compress and lowercase

name: ipv4-mapped-v6
exercises: IPv4-mapped IPv6 must normalise to IPv4

name: many-sans-1200
exercises: 1200 SANs; must truncate at 1000 and record the true count

name: no-sans
exercises: no SAN extension at all; CN only

name: serial-24-bytes
exercises: serial OVER the legal limit; occurs in the wild

name: serial-leading-zero
exercises: serial whose first byte is zero

name: empty-subject
exercises: no subject attributes; legal and increasingly common

name: comma-in-dn
exercises: attribute value containing a comma; must be escaped

name: multi-ou
exercises: several OU attributes; order must be preserved

name: critical-unknown-ext
exercises: critical extension we do not recognise

name: sha1-rsa
exercises: SHA-1 signature; deprecated and still deployed

name: bit-flipped-length
exercises: bit flip in the DER length header

name: bit-flipped-tag
exercises: bit flip in the outer tag

name: length-overflow
exercises: declared length far beyond the buffer
